Introduction

FIVE O ONE is a three-member South Korean group under HENECIA, formed by Kim Hyunjoong, Heo Youngsaeng, and Kim Kyujong—all original members of the iconic second-generation boy group SS501. The trio reunited to celebrate the 20th anniversary of their debut with a special project that includes a comeback and a global tour beginning in Seoul in July.

Known for hits like "Snow Prince," "Love Like This," "U R MAN," and "Because I'm Stupid," SS501 debuted in 2005 and became one of the most beloved groups of their era. Over the years, each member has pursued solo activities showcasing their individual talents, but they have now come together again as FIVE O ONE to create new memories with long-time fans.

Their return was announced with a teaser on their official YouTube channel, featuring the sound of a beating heart and shadowed glimpses of the members—building anticipation for their reunion. Details of the anniversary project will be released progressively through HENECIA’s official channels.
